verdict.rationale: Claude Code has no dedicated shared-workspace feature. It offers building blocks instead: CLAUDE.md files in the project root that every session reads and that hold team standards, architecture decisions and review checklists; shareable team skills; and MCP connectors that read design docs in Google Drive or Notion. A lead could assemble a common source of truth from these, but only as a repo-based workaround. Missing for 10: a first-class shared team workspace built from docs and repos, a way to ingest docs and repos into one shared knowledge base, team-level workspace management or permissions, and independent corroboration.
